svg.title: Where four chains put each species on the gradients
svg.desc: Two panels from one fit of simulated data with three gradients. Each of 48 species is drawn as a ring at its true position on the gradients, with four dots, one per chain, at the positions the four chains give it. The left panel shows gradients 1 and 2 and the right panel gradients 1 and 3. The four dots of a species fall close together and close to its ring.
svg.text: One fit, four chains: where each species sits on the gradients
The tips of the species' arrows, seen within the sheet. Simulated data with three gradients.
Where each of the four chains puts it, tied to its ring
The four chains agree on the set of gradients: 0.96 to 0.99, where 1 is the same set.
Their gradients hold 95 to 98 percent of the true signal.
In this same fit, 79 percent of single site-by-species values fail the R-hat check between chains.
